# KaTeX 0.19.1

Vendored from the official npm package `katex@0.19.1` (MIT).
https://katex.org/ · https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.19.1

Includes the unchanged ESM renderer, mhchem ESM extension, LICENSE, and WOFF2 fonts.
`katex.min.css` comes from `dist/katex-swap.min.css`; only obsolete WOFF/TTF fallback URLs were removed.
No runtime CDN, package manager, or build step is required. Keep renderer, CSS, fonts and mhchem at the same version when updating.
